title: Payment Runs, Capitation and Clean Claim Payment under Network Participation Agreements
content:
Cascade pays practices under the **Network Participation Agreements** through remittances. Each remittance advice lists what is paid, by component: claim payments, prompt-pay interest or capitation.

## 1. Payment runs and capitation (in force)

Claim payments are issued in payment runs every remittance cycle of days, which is 7 days under every agreement type. Where the agreement type requires electronic funds transfer, they are paid that way.

Capitation for a DHMO primary care dentist is the capitation rate per assigned member, paid on the capitation payment day for the current month. Under the Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement, that is 11.85 USD per assigned member, paid on the 15th.

## 2. Clean claims and prompt-pay interest

This clause is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current basis: *A clean claim is paid within the clean-claim period of calendar days of receipt; when it is paid later, simple interest at the prompt-pay interest rate per year is paid for each day beyond that period as a separate prompt-pay interest component, unless the interest is below the prompt-pay interest minimum.*

The figures the clause named remain those of the agreement type's payment table.

## 3. Member-pays agreements (in force)

A practice under a member-pays agreement receives no remittance. Under such an agreement, the member pays the discounted fee, which is the payment arrangement of the Cascade Savings Network Participating Provider Agreement.

## Who receives what

| Agreement type | Claim payment runs | Capitation |
|---|---|---|
| Cascade Savings Network Participating Provider Agreement | None (member pays the practice) | None |
| Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement | Every 7 days, by electronic funds transfer | Monthly, per assigned member, on the 15th |
| Vision, DHMO specialist, Premier and PPO agreements | Every 7 days, by electronic funds transfer | None |

**Hypothetical.** A primary care dentist with 520 assigned members in a month receives capitation of 520 times 11.85 USD, that is 6162.00 USD, on the 15th of that month.

superseded_clauses: A clean claim is paid within clean_claim_payment_days calendar days of receipt; when it is paid later, simple interest at prompt_pay_interest_annual_pct per year is paid for each day beyond that period as a separate prompt_pay_interest component, unless the interest is below prompt_pay_interest_minimum.
